thread:
ops-bot: INCIDENT CREATED · High routing error rate observed for EU region (error spike -> 5xx from routing layer). Pager duty: @Sanjay P (oncall) paged.

Sanjay P: seeing big 5xx spike, traffic is being spillovered to us from eu-west-2 -> eu-central-1. Customers reporting elevated latencies. digging in.

Ava R: noted, I'm attaching quick telemetry snapshot from 22:03 that shows route failures + fallback attempts. can we confirm which fallback model was in use?

Michael C: fallback model at time of spike was `redwood-alpha-1-quant` (tier: fallback-small, compat: tokenized-v1). suspect mismatch with region model variants after recent rollout.

Lina D: timeline from logs:
```
22:01:12 request routed to eu-west-2 primary
22:01:13 primary responded 504 (gateway timeout)
22:01:13 routing layer attempted fallback -> eu-central-1:alpha
22:01:13 fallback model returned 522 (model hung)
22:01:14 routing returned 500 to caller
22:01:15 spike repeats, concurrent failing connections backlog grows
```

Joel K: quick check: autoscale pools in eu-west-2 show no GPU OOMs, but a control-plane handshake to dedicated hosts failed. link to logs: https://logs.internal/redwood/2026/2037/route-spillover (redacted keys)

Sanjay P: marking customer-impacting: yes. we have degraded latency and 20% increase in error rate for sessions pinned to eu-west-2. Notifying support to open SEV-3. @Ava R can you start a short RCA doc; I'll capture timeline here.

Ava R: creating rca draft at https://confluence.redwood/investigations/2037001234-routing-fallback-draft. adding fields: timeline, hypothesis, mitigations, customer-impact, next-steps.

Michael C: hypothesis A: a recent routing-policy change (rollout id 2026-03-09-rtg) added a new spillover heuristic where tiered fallbacks prefer `alpha` variants across regions; we think those variants were not fully warmed/compatible leading to misroutes and model-level 522s.

Lina D: hypothesis B: KV-cache mismatch between region variants -> cold-start amplification. evidence: fallback traces show long kv fetch latencies prior to 522.

Joel K: dumping sampled request trace (pseudonymized): 
```
request_id=abc123 session=zz-9 route=conversational model=redwood-alpha-1-quant target_region=eu-central-1
trace:
  routing: select fallback eu-central-1:alpha
  connection: established -> handshake timeout 1200ms
  model: kv-fetch timeout -> runtime hung -> tcp reset
```

Sanjay P: live mitigation: rolling back routing-policy rollout to previous stable policy (2026-03-02). Initiated rollback at 22:12. Will watch error rate.

ops-bot: ROLLBACK EXECUTED by Sanjay P. Policy version set to 2026-03-02.

Ava R: immediate mitigation validated: error rate dropped from 21% -> 3% within 5 minutes. latency back to baseline for affected customers. patching notes into RCA.

Michael C: temporary workaround for paging teams: pin high-traffic customers to dedicated region variants (explicit routing) to avoid cross-region spillover until we patch the alpha variants.

Lina D: collecting logs for post-mortem: routing-layer, model-runtime, kv-store traces. I've exported 30m window to S3: s3://redwood-incident-archives/2037001234/ (access: eng-oncall + eng-runtime).

Joel K: action items assigned in doc:
- [Ava R] finish timeline + customer impact summary (due EOD)
- [Michael C] run compatibility test matrix for `alpha` variants across eu regions (due 24h)
- [Lina D] produce KV latency heatmap (due 12h)
- [Sanjay P] coordinate on-call handoff and SLAs gating (handoff at 23:00)

Sanjay P: handing off to Ava for night coverage. I'll add notes to pagerduty. @Joel K please escalate to infra if any host-level anomalies persist.

Ava R: taking over on-call coverage. key open questions in thread:
- Did the rollout skip warm-up signals for region-variant compatibility?
- Are there any capacity throttles at network/proxy layer causing handshake timeouts?

Michael C: provisional root cause (working): routing-policy rollout preferred cross-region alpha fallbacks that were not warmed/validated -> caused excessive cold-starts and kv latency -> model runtime hung -> 5xx cascade. Need test harness and gating for fallback variant compatibility.

Lina D: adding short reproduction steps to RCA for infra to reproduce locally.

Ava R: customer impact note: ~12 customers affected, two enterprise customers saw degraded responses for ~4 minutes. Support notified; we recommended token refunds and post-incident summary.

ops-bot: NOTE: Next on-call is @Michael C at 23:00 UTC.

Sanjay P: leaving final note: I will follow up tomorrow with a short changelist to add to rollout gating (warm-up, compat checks, kv-latency thresholds). good job team. :thumbsup:

Ava R: closing thread for active mitigation. will keep RCA draft open for comments.
